content.title: 'Easter 2026' what stores are open and closed
content.text: Easter is literally around the corner so for those who need to do any last-minute shopping, you may want to head out as soon as you can.Some grocery stores and retail stores will be closed for the holiday, which is on April 5 this year.Also, keep in mind that some businesses may be closed on Good Friday leading up to Easter Sunday.It’s probably best to call the store before you head out to confirm their holiday hours.Most of the major grocery store chains remain open on Easter, but some may have modified hours, so you may want to check.What grocery stores or retail stores are open on Easter Sunday in 2026?Here's a list of stores expected to be open on Easter Sunday.These stores will be open at most locations on Easter or are expected to be open based on recent holiday participation.Please call ahead to your local store, as there are always exceptions:Ace HardwareAcmeBarnes & NobleBass Pro ShopsBig LotsBJs Wholesale ClubCVSDollar GeneralFamily DollarFresh MarketGameStopHome DepotIKEAOld NavyPetcoPetSmartRoyal FarmsSave-A-Lot7-ElevenSephoraShopRite (some are closed, so check with your local store)SproutsTrader Joe'sWalgreen'sWalmartWawaWhole FoodsSome fast-food chains, restaurants open on EasterApplebee’sBahama BreezeBenihanaBob EvansBonefish GrillBoston MarketBrio Italian GrilleBuffalo Wild WingsBurger KingCarrabba’s Italian GrillChili’sCracker BarrelDairy QueenDenny’sDomino’sDunkin’Eddie V’s Prime SeafoodFamous Dave’sFirebirds Wood-Fired GrillFive GuysFleming’s SteakhouseIHOPJimmy John’sKFCLongHorn SteakhouseMaggiano’sMcDonald’sOlive GardenOutback SteakhouseP.F. MaxxNJ Motor Vehicle Offices are closed on Good Friday, banks, post offices are openAccording to a press release from New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission (NJMVC), all NJMVC facilities, including agencies, road test sites, and inspection stations, will be closed Friday, April 3 in observance of the state holiday, it stated.Regular operations will be in effect at NJMVC facilities the rest of the week, including on Saturday, April 4, the release stated.The Commission’s website at NJMVC.gov remains open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.U.S. banks are open on Good Friday since it is not a federal holiday.The U.S. Postal Service is also open on Good Friday for normal mail delivery and retail services.It is, of course, closed on Easter Sunday since Sundays are standard non-delivery days. Priority Mail Express, which is delivered 365 days a year, is the exception.Please consider a digital subscription to help support our journalism.This article originally appeared on Cherry Hill Courier-Post: Easter 2026 store hours and closures
